name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle on two or three wheels other than a moped, scooters included; an electric two-wheeler that's neither a power bicycle nor a limited-speed motorcycle, such as a fast e-moto or a street-plated electric dirt bike, is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels; includes what the trade calls motorcycles and scooters
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 1(1)(w)

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed; one that meets the federal limited-speed motorcycle definition is a moped instead
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 1(1)(w); Use of Highway and Rules of the Road Regulation, Alta. Reg. 304/2002, s. 1(1)(i)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 licence, issued from age 16; a Class 7 learner 16 or older, or a Class 1 to 5 holder, may ride only with a supervising rider, and a learner not at night
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 51; Operator Licensing and Vehicle Control Regulation, Alta. Reg. 320/2002, ss. 26, 28, 29 and 32

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting a motorcycle helmet standard, except a Sikh rider 18 or older who wears a turban
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, ss. 107 and 108

restrictions.rule: Carrying a passenger needs a pillion seat, hand grips and foot rests
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment Regulation, Alta. Reg. 122/2009, s. 109

restrictions.rule: Must be registered, plated and insured
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, ss. 52 to 54

restrictions.rule: One built for cross-country travel and ridden off the highway is an off-highway vehicle
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, R.S.A. 2000, c. T-6, s. 117(a)
